explanation_full: The time-series diagnostics show that the KNN model performed well, achieving a sequence correlation of 0.9315. Specifically, the actual peak value was 1.0 at index 130, while the model predicted a value of 0.8299 at index 146. The mean absolute gap was 0.0666, indicating a relatively small average difference between the actual and predicted values. Overall, the model demonstrates a strong ability to track changes over time, suggesting reliable performance in predicting temporal trends. However, the difference in peak timing (actual at 130 vs. predicted at 146) suggests a slight lag or shift in the predicted timing of the peak event, which users should be aware of when interpreting the results.
